lesson.title: Wonder Through Antifragility
lesson.topic: Exploring how embracing wonder and curiosity can make individuals more antifragile in their approach to learning and problem-solving.
lesson.steelman: How does fostering a sense of wonder contribute to personal resilience and adaptability in the face of uncertainty?
lesson.example: Using historical figures like Einstein or Newton, who maintained a childlike sense of awe about the universe while making groundbreaking discoveries.

rationale: Integrates wonder with antifragility, encouraging learners to view challenges through a lens of curiosity and resilience.
